newsitem.title: USA: Wheeling-Pittsburgh workers go on strike.
newsitem.headline: Wheeling-Pittsburgh workers go on strike.

text.p: Workers at WHX Corp's Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel Corp have gone on strike after union leaders failed to agree on the terms of a new labor contract with company officials.
Wheeling-Pittsburgh said on Monday the workers had gone on strike at eight of its facilities. It did not say how many facilities it had in all or if the strike would affect production.
It said its officials failed to reach an agreement with representatives of the United Steelworkers of America union to replace the former labor contract after nearly a month of negotiations.
The former contract expires October 1, it added.
"No negotiations have been scheduled, however, the company ... remains willing and available to resume talks," it said in a statement.
Wheeling-Pittsburgh is the ninth largest domestic integrated steel producer.
